gradient.$description: Gradients, written as CSS background images (the build keeps them as strings; references to palette colours are resolved). Each becomes a utility bg-gradient-<name>. Values are read from the Figma nodes (gradient transforms converted to CSS angles).

wordmark.$description: Wordmark text fill ('intlabs.', 'LIFE Bank.'): pink to blue, left to right.

sheen.$description: The white sheen over solid buttons (btnPublish: a white-to-pink gradient at 24% over the fill, which reads as white 24% fading out).

sheen-hover.$description: The hover sheen of the primary button (btnPublish Variant9: #f86faa to #f9137d at 32%).

rim.$description: The 3 px inner highlight rim of solid buttons ('1px Highlight' stroke: white 25% to 0%).

glow.$description: The blurred blobs behind the primary button ('Background Blur', 5% at rest, 32% on hover).

indigo.$description: The indigo button fill (Figma 'Primary button', unused in the final screens).

kpi-bar.$description: The player KPI bar over white (Navbar Variant2): slate 300 at 15% fading out, then a hard stop about halfway that greys the second row (slate 300 at 41% to slate 100 at 64%). Today's KPI bar uses the same stops.
